title: built-in descriptors carry the pre-registered [perf]
observed: 14/14 descriptor facts as in decisions 4, 5 and 2

perf.source: pg_stat_statements (top-level statement executions in the measured database)
setup: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements
begin: SELECT pg_stat_statements_reset(0::oid, (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = {db}), 0::bigint)
perf.read: SELECT query, calls FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = {db}) AND toplevel ORDER BY query, queryid

perf.source: system.query_log (initial queries finished or failed in the measured database)
perf.read: SELECT query, 1 FROM system.query_log WHERE current_database = {db} AND is_initial_query = 1 AND type != 'QueryStart' AND toUnixTimestamp64Micro(query_start_time_microseconds) >= {mark} ORDER BY query_start_time_microseconds, event_time_microseconds, query SETTINGS final = 0
